abstract: "The *Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin* (KMO) *index* is a measure of sampling adequacy used by researchers to assess whether a data matrix is factorable prior to a factor analysis. Since its conception, the KMO index has remained a frequentist statistic, leaving researchers unable to employ the advantages of Bayesian inference when assessing sampling adequacy. Building on the increasing relevance of the Bayesian statistical approach, as well as advancements in Markov-Chain Monte Carlo methods, the author proposes a reconceptualization of the KMO index within the Bayesian framework that enables researchers to incorporate prior information and make coherent probabilistic statements about the sampling adequacy of a data matrix.©^[**License**: Except where otherwise indicated, all contents of this document and associated files are licensed under the *Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License* ([CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)). # Define QoL Rounding functions
```{r prespecifications, include=FALSE}
round_up <- function(x = NULL, digits = 3, add = FALSE, threshold = 0){
  require(scrutiny)
  require(weights)
  
  stopifnot(length(x) > 0)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  
  stopifnot(length(digits) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(digits))
  stopifnot(digits >= 0)
  digits <- ceiling(digits)
  
  stopifnot(length(add) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.logical(add))
  
  stopifnot(length(threshold) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(threshold))
  stopifnot(is.finite(threshold))
  
  x_rounded <- ifelse(
    x > threshold,
    weights::rd(scrutiny::round_up(x, digits = digits), digits = digits, add = add),
    weights::rd(scrutiny::round_down(x, digits = digits), digits = digits, add = add)
  )

  return(x_rounded)
}
round_down <- function(x = NULL, digits = 3, add = FALSE, threshold = 0){
  require(scrutiny)
  require(weights)
  
  stopifnot(length(x) > 0)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  
  stopifnot(length(digits) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(digits))
  stopifnot(digits >= 0)
  digits <- ceiling(digits)
  
  stopifnot(length(add) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.logical(add))
  
  stopifnot(length(threshold) == 1)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(threshold))
  stopifnot(is.finite(threshold))
  
  x_rounded <- ifelse(
    x > threshold,
    weights::rd(scrutiny::round_down(x, digits = digits), digits = digits, add = add),
    weights::rd(scrutiny::round_up(x, digits = digits), digits = digits, add = add)
  )

  return(x_rounded)
}


# Define QoL Formatting function
qformat <- function(x = NULL, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, big.mark = ","){
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  stopifnot(is.logical(scientific))
  stopifnot(is.logical(trim))
  stopifnot(is.character(big.mark))
  return(format(x, scientific = scientific, trim = trim, big.mark = big_mark))
}


# Define Maximum-likelihood functions
var2 <- function(x = NULL, x_mean = NULL, na.rm = FALSE){
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  stopifnot(is.logical(na.rm))
  if(!is.null(x_mean)){
    stopifnot(is.numeric(x_mean))
  }else{
    x_mean <- mean(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  }
  x_var <- mean((x - x_mean)^2, na.rm = na.rm)
  return(x_var)
}
sd2 <- function(x = NULL, x_mean = NULL, na.rm = FALSE){
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  stopifnot(is.logical(na.rm))
  if(!is.null(x_mean)){
    stopifnot(is.numeric(x_mean))
  }else{
    x_mean <- mean(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  }
  x_sd <- sqrt(var2(x = x, x_mean = x_mean, na.rm = FALSE))
  return(x_sd)
}
standardize2 <- function(x = NULL, x_mean = NULL, x_sd = NULL, na.rm = FALSE){
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  stopifnot(is.logical(na.rm))
  if(!is.null(x_mean)){
    stopifnot(is.numeric(x_mean))
  }else{
    x_mean <- mean(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  }
  if(!is.null(x_sd)){
    stopifnot(is.numeric(x_sd))
    stopifnot(x_sd > 0)
  }else{
    x_sd <- sd2(x = x, x_mean = x_mean, na.rm = na.rm)
  }
  x_standardized <- (x - x_mean) / x_sd
  return(x_standardized)
}


# Define Anti-image Correlation Matrix function
cor_anti_image <- function(R = NULL){
  inv_R <- solve(R)
  P <- -inv_R / sqrt(outer(diag(inv_R), diag(inv_R)))
  return(P)
}


# Define 'Little Jiffy, Mark IV' KMO index function
msa2 <- function(R = NULL){
  if (!is.matrix(R)) stop("Input must be a matrix.")
  if (!all(R == t(R))) stop("Matrix must be symmetric.")
  inv_R <- solve(R)
  P <- -inv_R / sqrt(outer(diag(inv_R), diag(inv_R)))
  r2 <- R^2
  p2 <- P^2
  diag(r2) <- 0
  diag(p2) <- 0
  kmo_i <- rowSums(r2) / (rowSums(r2) + rowSums(p2))
  kmo_overall <- sum(r2) / (sum(r2) + sum(p2))
  return(list(overall = kmo_overall, individual = kmo_i))
}


# Define Bayesian KMO index function
BKMO <- function(r = NULL){
  if(!is.matrix(r)) r <- as.matrix(r)
  
  # Compute p (i.e., number of theorized manifestations)
  disc <- sqrt(1 + 8 * ncol(r))
  p <- (1 + disc) / 2
  
  # Define utility function for vectorization
  utility_KMO <- function(r = r, p = p){
    # Construct correlation matrix 
    R <- diag(1, p)
    R[upper.tri(R)] <- r
    R[lower.tri(R)] <- t(R)[lower.tri(R)]
    row.names(R) <- paste0('m', 1:p)
    colnames(R) <- paste0('m', 1:p)
    
    # Compute inverse R
    R_inv <- solve(R)
    
    # Compute anti-image R
    R_q <- -R_inv / sqrt(outer(diag(R_inv), diag(R_inv)))
    
    # Compute KMO
    r2 <- R^2
    q2 <- R_q^2
    diag(r2) <- 0
    diag(q2) <- 0
    kmo <- c(rowSums(r2) / (rowSums(r2) + rowSums(q2)), overall = sum(r2) / (sum(r2) + sum(q2)))
    return(kmo)
  }
  
  # Compute KMO for each posterior draw using vectorization
  bkmo <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(r), function(i) utility_KMO(r = r[i, , drop = FALSE], p = p)))
  return(as.data.frame(bkmo))
}
```

```{r load_data, include = FALSE}

# Load data from EFA.dimensions
data(data_RSE)
df <- data_RSE


# Save data
# write.csv(df, "Data/data_Rosenberg1985.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Rename columns
colnames(df) <- paste0("theta_", 1:ncol(df))


# Standardize data
df <- apply(df, 2, datawizard::standardize) %>% as.data.frame()


# Power analysis
sesoi <- 0.3
sesed <- pwr::pwr.r.test(nrow(df), sig.level = alpha, power = 1-beta, alternative = "two.sided")$r
sesed <- sesed %>% round_down(digits = digits$text)
power_sesoi <- pwr::pwr.r.test(nrow(df), r = sesoi, sig.level = alpha, alternative = "two.sided")$power
power_sesoi <- ifelse(power_sesoi > .999, .999, power_sesoi)
power_sesoi <- paste0((power_sesoi*100) %>% round_down(digits = 1), "%")


# Compute VIF
lm1 <- lm(theta_1 ~ ., df)
vifs <- performance::check_collinearity(lm1)$VIF
vifs_interpretation <- vifs %>% effectsize::interpret_vif()
lowest_vif <- paste0("$\\forall \\theta_m: VIF \\leq ", min(vifs) %>% round_up(digits = digits$text), "$")


# performance::check_heteroskedasticity(lm1)
# Warning: Heteroscedasticity (non-constant error variance) detected (p < .001).
# performance::check_outliers(lm1)
# lmtest::resettest(lm1)
# RESET = 5, df1 = 2, df2 = 288, p-value = 0.006


# Compute correlation matrix
R <- cor(df)
R_inv <- solve(R)


# Compute anti-image correlation matrix
R_q <- -R_inv
diag(R_q) <- diag(R_inv)
R_q <- R_q / sqrt(outer(diag(R_q), diag(R_q)))


# Compute KMO
kmo_indices <- msa2(R)


# Compute KMO index with psych for comparison
kmo_indices_psych <- psych::KMO(df)


# Construct matrix with results
cor_parcor <- R %>% as.matrix()
cor_parcor[upper.tri(cor_parcor)] <- R_q[upper.tri(R_q)]
diag(cor_parcor) <- kmo_indices$individual %>% as.vector()
colnames(cor_parcor) <- paste0("$\\theta_{", 1:ncol(df), "}$")
row.names(cor_parcor) <- paste0("$\\theta_{", 1:ncol(df), "}$")
```

```{r bootstrapping_data, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING

# Compute bootstrap of KMO index
bootstrapped_kmo <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_samples, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
  df_i <- df[sample(1:nrow(df), nrow(df), replace = TRUE),]
  row.names(df_i) <- NULL
  kmo_i <- msa2(cor(df_i))
  kmos_i <- kmo_i$individual |> as.matrix() |> t() |> as.data.frame()
  output_i <- data.frame(kmo_overall = kmo_i$overall)
  output_i <- cbind(output_i, kmos_i)
  return(output_i)
}


# Save results
write.csv(bootstrapped_kmo, "Data/bootstrapped_kmo.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r R_bglm_fit, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING

# Standardize data matrix
df <- apply(df, 2, standardize2) %>% as.data.frame()


# Specify Gaussian multivariate model
R_bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(theta_1, theta_2, theta_3, theta_4, theta_5, theta_6, theta_7, theta_8, theta_9, theta_10) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify 'weakly informative' model priors
R_bglm_prior_weakly <- brms::set_prior("lkj(2)", class = "rescor")


# Sample 'weakly informative' prior
R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly <- brms::brm(
  formula = R_bglm_model,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  ),
  prior = R_bglm_prior_weakly,
  data = df, 
  chains = chains,
  cores = cores,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = SEED,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  file = "Data/R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly",
  file_refit = "on_change",
  control = list(adapt_delta = .99),
  sample_prior = "only"
)
# summary(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly)


# Sample posterior and prior
R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly <- brms::brm(
  formula = R_bglm_model,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  ),
  prior = R_bglm_prior_weakly,
  data = df, 
  chains = chains,
  cores = cores,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = SEED,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  file = "Data/R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly",
  file_refit = "on_change",
  control = list(adapt_delta = .99)
)
# summary(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly)


# Change to 'non-informative' (i.e., uniform) prior
R_bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior("lkj(1)", class = "rescor")


# Sample posterior
R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative <- brms::brm(
  formula = R_bglm_model,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  ),
  prior = R_bglm_prior_noninformative,
  data = df, 
  chains = chains,
  cores = cores,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = SEED,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  file = "Data/R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative",
  file_refit = "on_change",
  control = list(adapt_delta = .99)
)
# summary(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative)
```

```{r traceplots, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING

# Specify colors
traceplot_color_chart <- Polychrome::palette36.colors(cores) %>% as.vector()


# Assess sampled 'weakly informative' prior: Rhat, ESS, MCSE, and Traceplots
R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary <- posterior::summarize_draws(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples, default_convergence_measures(), default_mcse_measures()) %>% as.data.frame()
all(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$rhat[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)] < 1.01) # TRUE: All Rhat less than 1.01
min(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$ess_bulk[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All bulk ESS at least 22,144
min(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$ess_tail[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All tail ESS at least 26,847
max(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$mcse_mean[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All MCSE at most 0.00186
R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly %>%
bayesplot::mcmc_trace(regex_pars = c("rescor__"), n_warmup = warmup, np = nuts_params(R_bglm_prior_fit_weakly)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  labs(
    color = "Chain"
  )


# Assess sampled posterior with 'weakly informative' prior: Rhat, ESS, MCSE, and Traceplots
R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary <- posterior::summarize_draws(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples, default_convergence_measures(), default_mcse_measures()) %>% as.data.frame()
all(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$rhat[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)] < 1.01) # TRUE: All Rhat less than 1.01
min(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$ess_bulk[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All bulk ESS at least 17,576
min(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$ess_tail[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All tail ESS at least 24,375
max(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$mcse_mean[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly_samples_summary$variable)]) # All MCSE at most 0.000339
R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly %>%
bayesplot::mcmc_trace(regex_pars = c("rescor__"), n_warmup = warmup, np = nuts_params(R_bglm_posterior_fit_weakly)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  labs(
    color = "Chain"
  )


# Assess sampled posterior with 'noninformative' prior: Rhat, ESS, MCSE, and Traceplots
R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary <- posterior::summarize_draws(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples, default_convergence_measures(), default_mcse_measures()) %>% as.data.frame()
all(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$rhat[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$variable)] < 1.01) # TRUE: All Rhat less than 1.01
min(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$ess_bulk[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$variable)]) # All bulk ESS at least 19,037
min(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$ess_tail[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$variable)]) # All tail ESS at least 26,003
max(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$mcse_mean[grep("^rescor__", R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative_samples_summary$variable)]) # All MCSE at most 0.000328
R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative %>%
bayesplot::mcmc_trace(regex_pars = c("rescor__"), n_warmup = warmup, np = nuts_params(R_bglm_posterior_fit_noninformative)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traceplot_color_chart) +
  labs(
    color = "Chain"
  )
```

```{r simulation_condition1, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 1 ##
# - 1 factor
# - 3 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: sedes
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 3
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent = rnorm(population_size)
)
for(k in 1:n_manifestations){
  df_population[,paste0("m", k)] <- sedes*df_population$latent + rnorm(population_size)
}
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)


# Create dataframe for results
results_sample_size <- data.frame(
  kmo_overall_population = rep(kmo_population$overall, n_simulations),
  kmo_m1_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m1"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m2_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m2"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m3_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m3"], n_simulations),
  
  rmse_kmo_overall = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m1 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m2 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m3 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  
  rmse_bkmo_overall_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m1_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m2_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m3_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  
  rmse_bkmo_overall_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m1_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m2_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m3_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  
  rmse_bkmo_overall_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m1_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m2_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_bkmo_m3_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_low_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_se_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations)
)


# Simulate comparison
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_simulations, style = 3)
for(j in 1:n_simulations){
  
  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"]
      )
    )
  }
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_overall[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m1[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m2[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m3[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))
  
  
  # BKMO
  df_sample_std_bayes_j <- apply(df_sample_j, 2, standardize2) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  
  # Fit Bayesian multivariate linear model with liberal prior
  bglm_fit_j <- brms::brm(
    formula = bglm_model,
    family = gaussian(
      link = "identity"
    ),
    prior = bglm_prior_liberal,
    data = df_sample_std_bayes_j, 
    chains = 1,
    cores = 1,
    iter = posterior_draws + warmup_draws,
    warmup = warmup_draws,
    seed = SEED,
    silent = 2,
    refresh = 0,
    open_progress = FALSE
  )
  summary(bglm_fit_j)
  
  # Extract posterior draws of the (residual) correlations from the fitted Bayesian model
  bglm_draws_j <- brms::as_draws_df(bglm_fit_j)
  bglm_correlations_j <- bglm_draws_j[, stringr::str_detect(colnames(bglm_draws_j), "rescor__")]
  
  # Compute Bayesian KMO index
  bkmo_sample_j <- BKMO(r = bglm_correlations_j)
  
  # Save results
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_overall_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m1_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m2_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m3_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_liberal[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_liberal[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall)
  tmp_quantile_inverval <- quantile(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_liberal[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_liberal[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_liberal[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$m1 - bkmo_sample_j$m1)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_liberal[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$m1 - bkmo_sample_j$m1)
```

```{r simulation_condition2, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 2 ##
# - 1 factor
# - 3 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: 0 (NOTE: Setting this to 0 is equivalent to specifying 3 factors)
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 3
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent = rnorm(population_size)
)
for(k in 1:n_manifestations){
  df_population[,paste0("m", k)] <- 0*df_population$latent + rnorm(population_size)
}
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)


# Create dataframe for results
results_sample_size <- data.frame(
  kmo_overall_population = rep(kmo_population$overall, n_simulations),
  kmo_m1_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m1"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m2_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m2"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m3_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m3"], n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations)
)


# Simulate comparison
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_simulations, style = 3)
for(j in 1:n_simulations){
  
  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"]
      )
    )
  }
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_overall[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m1[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m2[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m3[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))
  
  
  # BKMO
  df_sample_std_bayes_j <- apply(df_sample_j, 2, standardize2) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  
  # Fit Bayesian multivariate linear model with liberal prior
  bglm_fit_j <- brms::brm(
    formula = bglm_model,
    family = gaussian(
      link = "identity"
    ),
    prior = bglm_prior_liberal,
    data = df_sample_std_bayes_j, 
    chains = 1,
    cores = 1,
    iter = posterior_draws + warmup_draws,
    warmup = warmup_draws,
    seed = SEED,
    silent = 2,
    refresh = 0,
    open_progress = FALSE
  )
  summary(bglm_fit_j)
  
  # Extract posterior draws of the (residual) correlations from the fitted Bayesian model
  bglm_draws_j <- brms::as_draws_df(bglm_fit_j)
  bglm_correlations_j <- bglm_draws_j[, stringr::str_detect(colnames(bglm_draws_j), "rescor__")]
  
  # Compute Bayesian KMO index
  bkmo_sample_j <- BKMO(r = bglm_correlations_j)
  
  # Save results
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_overall_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m1_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m2_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_bkmo_m3_liberal[j] <- sqrt(mean((bkmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_liberal[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_liberal[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall)
  tmp_quantile_inverval <- quantile(kmo_sample_j$overall - bkmo_sample_j$overall, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_liberal[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_liberal[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
```

```{r simulation_condition3, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 3 ##
# - 1 factor
# - 10 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: sedes
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 10
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent = rnorm(population_size)
)
for(k in 1:n_manifestations){
  df_population[,paste0("m", k)] <- sedes*df_population$latent + rnorm(population_size)
}
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9, m10) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)

  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"],
        m4 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m4"],
        m5 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m5"],
        m6 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m6"],
        m7 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m7"],
        m8 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m8"],
        m9 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m9"],
        m10 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m10"]
      )
    )
```

```{r simulation_condition4, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 4 ##
# - 1 factor
# - 5 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: sedes
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 5
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent = rnorm(population_size)
)
for(k in 1:n_manifestations){
  df_population[,paste0("m", k)] <- sedes*df_population$latent + rnorm(population_size)
}
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)


# Create dataframe for results
results_sample_size <- data.frame(
  kmo_overall_population = rep(kmo_population$overall, n_simulations),

# Simulate comparison
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_simulations, style = 3)
for(j in 1:n_simulations){
  
  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"],
        m4 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m4"],
        m5 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m5"]
      )
    )
  }
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_overall[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m1[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m2[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m3[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m4[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m4 - results_sample_size$kmo_m4_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m5[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m5 - results_sample_size$kmo_m5_population[j])^2))

  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m5_ci_high_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  
  
  
  # Update progress bar
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, j)
}

results_sample_size$n_factors <- 1

write.csv(results_sample_size, "Simulations/condition4.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r simulation_condition5, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 5 ##
# - 1 factor
# - 3 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: 2*sedes
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 3
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent = rnorm(population_size)
)
for(k in 1:n_manifestations){
  df_population[,paste0("m", k)] <- 2*sedes*df_population$latent + rnorm(population_size)
}
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)


# Create dataframe for results
results_sample_size <- data.frame(
  kmo_overall_population = rep(kmo_population$overall, n_simulations),
  kmo_m1_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m1"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m2_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m2"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m3_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m3"], n_simulations),

)


# Simulate comparison
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_simulations, style = 3)
for(j in 1:n_simulations){
  
  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"]
      )
    )
  }
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_overall[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m1[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m1 - results_sample_size$kmo_m1_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m2[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m3[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))

  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_high_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_conservative[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_conservative[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3)
  tmp_quantile_inverval <- quantile(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  
  
  
  # Update progress bar
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, j)
}
results_sample_size$sample_size <- sample_sizes
results_sample_size$factor_loading <- 2*sedes
results_sample_size$n_factors <- 1
results_sample_size$n_manifestations <- n_manifestations
write.csv(results_sample_size, "Simulations/condition5.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r simulation_condition6, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING


## CONDITION 6 ##
# - 2 factors
# - 3 manifestations
# - Factor loadings: sedes
# - Varying priors: LKJ(0.5), LKJ(1), and LKJ(2)
# - Varying sample sizes


# Power analysis
smallest_sample_size <- 30
sedes <- pwr::pwr.r.test(n = smallest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r
largest_sample_size <- 1000
pwr::pwr.r.test(n = largest_sample_size, sig.level = alpha, power = 1- beta)$r


# Bootstrap / MCMC specifications
posterior_draws <- 1000
warmup_draws <- 100


# Specify population
n_manifestations <- 3
population_size <- 1000000
df_population <- data.frame(
  latent1 = rnorm(population_size),
  latent2 = rnorm(population_size)
)
df_population[,paste0("m", 1)] <- sedes*df_population$latent1 + rnorm(population_size)
df_population[,paste0("m", 2)] <- sedes*df_population$latent1 + rnorm(population_size)
df_population[,paste0("m", 3)] <- sedes*df_population$latent2 + rnorm(population_size)
df_population <- df_population %>% select(-c(latent1, latent2))
corr_matrix <- cor(df_population)
kmo_population <- msa2(corr_matrix)


# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 100


# Sample sizes to vary
sample_sizes <- ceiling(seq(smallest_sample_size, largest_sample_size, length.out = n_simulations))


# Specify Bayesian model
bglm_model <- brms::bf(
  mvbind(m1, m2, m3) ~ 0,
  sigma ~ 0,
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  )
) + set_rescor(TRUE)


# Specify model priors
bglm_prior_liberal <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(0.5)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_noninformative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(1)", class = "rescor"
)
bglm_prior_conservative <- brms::set_prior(
  "lkj(2)", class = "rescor"
)


# Create dataframe for results
results_sample_size <- data.frame(
  kmo_overall_population = rep(kmo_population$overall, n_simulations),
  kmo_m1_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m1"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m2_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m2"], n_simulations),
  kmo_m3_population = rep(kmo_population$individual["m3"], n_simulations),
  
  rmse_kmo_overall = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m1 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m2 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  rmse_kmo_m3 = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_high_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_liberal = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_overall_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_se_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_low_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m1_ci_high_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),
  diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_noninformative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations),

  diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_conservative = rep(NA_real_, n_simulations)
)


# Simulate comparison
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_simulations, style = 3)
for(j in 1:n_simulations){
  
  # Specify sample size for the jth simulation
  sample_size_j <- sample_sizes[j]
  
  # Specify sample
  df_sample_j <- df_population[sample(1:nrow(df_population), sample_size_j, replace = FALSE),]
  row.names(df_sample_j) <- NULL
  
  # Frequentist KMO
  kmo_sample_j <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:posterior_draws, .combine = "rbind") %dopar% {
    library(tidyverse)
    library(datawizard)
    library(psych)
    df_sample_i <- df_sample_j[sample(1:nrow(df_sample_j), nrow(df_sample_j), replace = TRUE),]
    row.names(df_sample_i) <- NULL
    corr_matrix_freq_i <- cor(df_sample_i)
    kmo_freq_i <- msa2(corr_matrix_freq_i)
    return(
      data.frame(
        overall = kmo_freq_i$overall,
        m1 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m1"],
        m2 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m2"],
        m3 = kmo_freq_i$individual["m3"]
      )
    )
  }
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_overall[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$overall - results_sample_size$kmo_overall_population[j])^2))

  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m2[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m2 - results_sample_size$kmo_m2_population[j])^2))
  results_sample_size$rmse_kmo_m3[j] <- sqrt(mean((kmo_sample_j$m3 - results_sample_size$kmo_m3_population[j])^2))

  # Fit Bayesian multivariate linear model with liberal prior

    formula = bglm_model,
    family = gaussian(
      link = "identity"
    ),

  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_mean_conservative[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$m2 - bkmo_sample_j$m2)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_se_conservative[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$m2 - bkmo_sample_j$m2)
  tmp_quantile_inverval <- quantile(kmo_sample_j$m2 - bkmo_sample_j$m2, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_low_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m2_ci_high_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_mean_conservative[j] <- mean(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_se_conservative[j] <- sd2(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3)
  tmp_quantile_inverval <- quantile(kmo_sample_j$m3 - bkmo_sample_j$m3, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_low_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[1]
  results_sample_size$diff_kmo_bkmo_m3_ci_high_conservative[j] <- tmp_quantile_inverval[2]
  
  
  # Update progress bar
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, j)
}
results_sample_size$sample_size <- sample_sizes
results_sample_size$factor_loading <- sedes
results_sample_size$n_factors <- 2
results_sample_size$n_manifestations <- n_manifestations
write.csv(results_sample_size, "Simulations/condition6.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r plot_condition1, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# NOT RUN DURING NORMAL RENDERING

# Conditions 1: RMSE Comparisons for varying priors and sample sizes
plot_condition1 <- data.frame(
  rmse_overall_type = c(
    rep("Frequentist", nrow(simulations_condition1)),
    rep("Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 0.5)", nrow(simulations_condition1)),
    rep("Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 1)", nrow(simulations_condition1)),
    rep("Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 2)", nrow(simulations_condition1))
  ) %>% factor(levels = c("Frequentist", "Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 0.5)", "Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 1)", "Bayesian ($\\eta$ = 2)")),
  rmse_overall = c(
    simulations_condition1$rmse_kmo_overall,
    simulations_condition1$rmse_bkmo_overall_liberal,
    simulations_condition1$rmse_bkmo_overall_noninformative,
    simulations_condition1$rmse_bkmo_overall_conservative
  ),
  sample_size = c(
    simulations_condition1$sample_size,
    simulations_condition1$sample_size,
    simulations_condition1$sample_size,
    simulations_condition1$sample_size
  )
) %>% ggplot(aes(x = sample_size, y = rmse_overall, group = rmse_overall_type, color = rmse_overall_type, linetype = rmse_overall_type, shape = rmse_overall_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, seq(100, 1000, 100))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.01)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 1000)) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample size",
    y = "RMSE",
    group = "Overall KMO index",
    color = "Overall KMO index",
    linetype = "Overall KMO index"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.4) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10))
  ) +
  theme_classic()
tikz("Plots/simulation_condition_samplesize.tikz", standAlone = FALSE, width = 7, height = 4, sanitize = FALSE)
print(plot_condition1)   # render the ggplot
dev.off()
```
